subject: CardioHub: governance & routing — clarifying BAA and audit doc needs
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cardiohub.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + asks (BAA / audit evidence)

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning, Alex — good conversation. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can triage hosting options (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) given CardioHub's compliance constraints.

Recap of constraints you called out:
- PHI in both inference inputs and stored payloads (EHR-derived notes and images).
- Requirement for a signed BAA before any production processing of PHI.
- SOC 2 Type II is a gating item for procurement; you indicated procurement wants SOC 2 report + controls mapping.
- Desire to keep latency < 200ms p50 for core inference paths.

Open asks / next steps from our side (we'll assemble these items unless you prefer otherwise):
1) Confirm whether CardioHub will consider Dedicated reserved capacity (Redwood Dedicated) initially, or if Private VPC/on-prem is required from day one. Your comment that procurement prefers Dedicated for predictable throughput was noted — please confirm.
2) Jenn (Legal): can you share any specific BAA clauses or templates that diverge from our standard? If you prefer, we can start with our standard BAA and flag any redlines.
3) Please attach the completed compliance questionnaire you mentioned on the call (we'll use that to pre-populate our evidence checklist).
4) We'll prepare a short evidence bundle: SOC 2 summary, summary of encryption at rest/in transit, data residency options, and our BAA draft. Expect this by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: postcall-action-items.pdf (slides + action list)

Proposed cadence: 30-min follow-up with procurement + legal next week (I can host). Are afternoons PT on Tue/Wed ok?

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cardiohub.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenn Walters <jenn.walters@cardiohub.io>, CardioHub Infrastructure <infra@cardiohub.io>
Date: 2027-04-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + asks (BAA / audit evidence)

Appreciate the clear recap, Camila — very helpful. A few quick points: 

- Confirmed: CardioHub will need a signed BAA before processing PHI in production.
- Preference: procurement is open to Redwood Dedicated for initial rollout (we like the predictability), but legal has asked us to evaluate Private VPC if there are any BAA-related constraints or if dedicated can't meet encryption/(HSM) requirements.
- Timeline: Procurement wants vendor-side SOC 2 artifacts (summary + controls map) within the next 10 business days to keep on schedule for a May POC start.

I've attached a filled compliance questionnaire and an internal note about latency SLAs. Also looping Jenn for legal-level follow-up.

Questions for you: 
1) If we start on Dedicated, can we get a short-term agreement that allows an auditable path to Private later without a long procurement cycle?
2) Can you confirm whether Redwood's Dedicated offering supports customer-managed KMS or HSM integrations for tenant key control?

Thanks — Alex

Attachments: CardioHub_Compliance_Questionnaire.xlsx

On Wed, Apr 7, 2027 at 09:12 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the demo this morning, Alex — good conversation. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can triage hosting options (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) given CardioHub's compliance constraints.

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Post-demo recap + asks (BAA / audit evidence) — CardioHub follow-up (action items)

Forwarding Alex's reply. Quick internal asks so we can respond in one reply to Alex / Jenn: 

1) Karthik — can you confirm the following for Redwood Dedicated: 
   - Customer-managed KMS/HSM options? If not full HSM, what key separation models do we offer?
   - Is there a simple contract addendum that allows a post-PO transition path from Dedicated -> Private VPC (i.e., migration playbook + data egress assumptions)?
   - Approximate lead time to provision a Dedicated pool sized for ~100 rps peak (we discussed predictable throughput).

2) Marissa — please pull our SOC 2 Type II summary + controls mapping (particularly controls around encryption, access control, and change management). Also flag any high-level SOC exceptions that might be relevant to CardioHub.

I want to respond to Alex with: (A) confirmation that Dedicated can be the initial path and the migration path exists; (B) list of evidence we'll share + ETA (10 business days); (C) offer of a written migration addendum draft.

I'll include the attachments (postcall-action-items.pdf) and propose Tue/Wed afternoons for the procurement/legal 30-min.

Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cardiohub.io>, Jenn Walters <jenn.walters@cardiohub.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: CardioHub next steps: Dedicated-first + evidence bundle and migration addendum

Alex / Jenn — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the questionnaire. Short answer: Dedicated-first is an acceptable path and we can support a documented migration path to Private VPC if you decide to move later. Details below and attachments.

What we'll deliver by 2027-04-19 (10 business days):
- SOC 2 Type II summary + controls mapping (high level) — Marissa has this on deck.
- BAA draft (our standard) + a short redline guide calling out items that most enterprise legal teams ask to change.
- KMS/HSM options summary: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS via cloud provider KMS integration for key-wrapping; full HSM-backed tenant keys are available for Private VPC (on-prem options support HSM connectors). Karthik will send a short technical note with exact capabilities.
- Migration addendum draft: outlines migration playbook, data egress responsibilities, and a 30‑day transition SLA for model/state transfer between Dedicated and Private.
- Evidence checklist spreadsheet with suggested owner columns for CardioHub to collect any internal artifacts you need to send us.

Can we lock a 30-min sync on Tue Apr 13 at 1:30pm PT? If not, Wed Apr 14 after 2pm PT also works. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Attachments: CardioHub_Scope.xlsx (scoping workbook), postcall-action-items.pdf

Next internal steps (cc'd): Karthik, please send the technical KMS/HSM note by EOD Mon 4/12. Marissa, please confirm SOC 2 doc availability and share the controls mapping by 4/19. I'll draft the migration addendum and BAA skeleton for legal review.

Thanks — Camila

--
